description: This file defines a PHP interface named 'Mail' within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Mail' namespace. The interface specifies methods for retrieving email-related information such as recipient lists, subject, body, and content type, which can be implemented by classes managing email functionality in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: A PHP interface that defines the structure for mail-related classes, including methods to access recipient lists, subject, body, and content type.

methods.name: getToList
methods.description: Returns an array of email addresses in the 'To' list.

methods.name: getCcList
methods.description: Returns an array of email addresses in the 'Cc' list or null if none.

methods.name: getBccList
methods.description: Returns an array of email addresses in the 'Bcc' list or null if none.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email subject as a string or null if not set.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the email body as a string or null if not set.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the email (e.g., 'text/html') or null.
